subject: POC padding request — integration delay & compensatory credits
messages:
From: Amandeep Singh <amandeep@finmerce.com>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finmerce Procurement <procurement@finmerce.com>, Finmerce SRE <sre@finmerce.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: POC timeline slip — can you help with more runway and credits?

Hi Aisha,

We ran into an unexpected blocker during the connector handoff. Our payments team found an edge case in the schema mapping that will take two full sprints to resolve — the vendor patch is already queued but the earliest deploy is three weeks out. That effectively stalls the PoC verification we planned for next week.

Given the delay, we have two asks:
- Can Redwood extend access to the sandbox/PoC environment by 21 days?
- Can you provision a small trial credit top-up (enough for ~100k tokens) so we can continue mock runs while we wait for the vendor patch?

We want to keep momentum — our exec sponsor is watching the November cadence closely. Attaching a short integration report that explains the blocker.

Thanks,
Amandeep Singh
Head of Platform
Finmerce

Attachment: MVP_integration_report.pdf (summary of DB schema mismatch and repro steps)

From: aisha_rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
To: Amandeep Singh <amandeep@finmerce.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC timeline slip — can you help with more runway and credits?

Hi Amandeep —

Thanks for the clear note and for the report — sorry to hear about the schema issue. We can absolutely try to help keep the PoC alive. I have looped in Ben (Sales Ops) and Dev (Solutions Eng) to confirm what we can do quickly from our side.

Quick asks for us to move faster:
1) Confirm the minimal token budget required for your mock runs (you suggested ~100k; please confirm the expected time window).
2) Can your SRE grant our team temporary read-only access to the connector logs so we can help triage? That would let our SEs reduce the time-to-fix.

Ben — can you review a compensatory credit/top-up and a 21-day environment extension for this PoC? Monica, can you help by dropping a one-page SOW amendment so Procurement can sign quickly if needed?

I’ll hold until I get approval on the credit & extension and then confirm with Amandeep.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
Cc: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 12:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC timeline slip — can you help with more runway and credits?

Aisha —

Approve in principle: we can give Finmerce a one-time compensatory credit equal to the value of 100k tokens and extend sandbox access by 21 days. Conditions:
- Credit to be issued as a one-off promo code tied to DL-20261109-FINM-01.
- Extension applied to the PoC sandbox only; no automatic extension for production.
- Procurement must sign the attached SOW amendment (Monica to prep).

Operational notes for Dev/SE: Dev, please review the attached integration report and see if SE can provide temporary log access instructions that keep data controls intact. Karthik, flag any security concerns for the PoC environment extension.

Monica — please draft the short SOW amendment (1 page) and link to the DocuSign. I’m ok issuing the promo once Procurement returns a signed SOW.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Sales Ops | Redwood Inference

Attachment: none (referencing SOW_draft_v2.docx to be created by Monica)

From: aisha_rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
To: Amandeep Singh <amandeep@finmerce.com>
Cc: Finmerce Procurement <procurement@finmerce.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC timeline slip — can you help with more runway and credits?

Hi Amandeep —

Good news: we can support the request. Summary of what Redwood will provide once Procurement signs the one-page amendment (attached):
- 100,000 token promo credit (promo code issued to Finmerce, valid for 30 days from issuance).
- Sandbox/PoC environment extended by 21 calendar days from the current expiration date.
- SE assistance: Dev will work with your SRE to provide a guided log-collection playbook (read-only) to speed the vendor triage.

Next steps for Finmerce:
1) Procurement — please review and countersign the attached SOW amendment (SOW_draft_v2.docx). If you prefer DocuSign, reply and we’ll send the link.
2) Amandeep/SRE — grant the temporary read-only log access (see playbook checklist attached) or confirm a window for a joint troubleshooting session.

I’ve attached the amendment draft and a short checklist for log access that Dev and our SEs use (minimal privileges). Once we have the signed SOW, Ben will issue the promo code and I’ll confirm exact dates.

If you want to jump on a quick call to align this afternoon, I’m available 4–5pm PT.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping this moving.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192

Attachments: SOW_draft_v2.docx, MVP_integration_report.pdf (resend), PoC_log_access_checklist.txt
